label: benign
title: Daughter keeps a birthday surprise secret
sources: Ambiguous benign: a secrecy phrase with a wholesome reason, no money/urgency

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Mom, don't tell Dad, but I'm throwing him a surprise party for his 70th.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh how fun! My lips are sealed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you keep him busy Saturday afternoon so I can set up?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I'll take him to the garden center, he loves that.
